note: Rejudged independently against RFC 9234 Section 4.1: "If the BGP Role is locally configured, the eBGP speaker MUST advertise the BGP Role Capability in the BGP OPEN message." TestExtractRoleCapabilities_ParseBGPConfig asserts one code-9 hex declaration and its selector for every role value 00 through 04, and no declaration for absent, empty or invalid roles. dynamic-peer-gets-group-role-capability.ci drives a real dynamic group with local Role RS, compares the entire OPEN including lengths and exactly one 090101 TLV, then requires End-of-RIB, dynamic-peer creation and establishment. Missing, wrong-valued or duplicate Role emission changes that exact wire assertion. The current path is extractRoleCapabilities through GetCapabilitiesForSelectors and Peer.pluginCapabilitySnapshot to buildOpenFromSnapshot; the snapshot preserves both the selected declaration and the capabilities derived from it. The local-role configuration and wire assertions are unchanged by this work. This replaces the obsolete current-producer references in the prior note and makes no new runtime or discrimination claim.
